@@U02864@@
When opportunity offers the best, we take it. But I wouldn’t turn down leftovers lovely as that.

@@U02866@@
I see her clearly enough, though I must confess to doubting that she’s authentic. The evidence of eyes can be misleading. And so I prefer to stick to the books, where it says that 海伦 delighted mightily all the graybeards of 特洛伊; a fact that fits quite well here. First, because I’m no longer young, and second, because I find her most attractive.

@@U02868@@
A boy no longer, but a man heroic and daring, he embraces her who can scarcely defend herself. His arms now strong, he lifts her high! Will he abduct her, I wonder?

@@U02870@@
Rash fool! How do you dare! You don’t listen! Stop! This is too much!

@@U02872@@
But it’s all your doing! It’s all in your mind, this spook play!

@@U02874@@
Just one word more. Considering all that’s happened, l'll call this piece “The Rape of 海伦.”
translation:
@@U02864@@
当机会提供最好的时，我们就会抓住它。但我不会拒绝如此可爱的剩菜。

@@U02866@@
我看得很清楚，尽管我必须承认我怀疑她的真实性。眼睛的证据可能会产生误导。所以我更愿意坚持看书本，书中说海伦让特洛伊的所有灰胡子都非常高兴；这个事实非常适合这里。一是因为我不再年轻了，二是因为我觉得她最有魅力。

@@U02868@@
他不再是一个男孩，而是一个英勇无畏的男人，他拥抱着几乎无法自卫的她。他的手臂现在变得有力，他把她高高举起！我想知道他会绑架她吗？

@@U02870@@
鲁莽的傻瓜！你怎么敢！你不听！停止！这太过分了！

@@U02872@@
但这都是你自己造成的！这一切都在你的脑海里，这就是恐怖游戏！

@@U02874@@
就再多说一个字吧。考虑到所发生的一切，我将这首作品命名为《海伦强奸案》。
